The Texas native has transformed into the quintessential Gen Z singer-songwriter by never losing sight of where he came from, still writing songs from his bedroom, hand-drawing his art, and designing a world without comparison. Conan turns the page to his next chapter in 2025 with his fourth full-length album, Wishbone, out now. 2020 saw Conan leave his mark on pop culture with his full-length debut, Kid Krow. Produced by longtime collaborator and GRAMMY® Award winner Dan Nigro, it bowed at #5 on the Billboard 200, went Platinum, and yielded a series of signature smashes. His 4x-Platinum hit “Heather” has become one among a small handful of songs with 2 billion streams penned by only one writer – Conan himself. With 12 billion total streams to date, Conan returned to the top of the charts with his second and third albums, Superache (2022) and Found Heaven (2024). In 2024, Conan took flight as an arena headliner, selling out legendary venues such as Madison Square Garden, the Kia Forum, and Wembley Arena. Beyond thriving as a songwriter and performer, Conan serves as the core creative director for his project, meticulously shaping every layer of his vision. He continues this trend with his fourth studio album, Wishbone – 12 self-written songs from a world all his own – out now.Discovered onShow allThis Is Conan GrayThis is Conan Gray.
